title: Starlink Now Available on Jumia Senegal
summary: Dakar, Senegal, August 28, 2026: Jumia, the leading e-commerce platform in Africa, announces the availability of the Starlink Standard Kit V4 on its marketplace in Senegal, providing consumers and businesses with easier access to reliable, high-speed satellite internet connectivity.
body_markdown:
### Customers can now purchase the Starlink Standard Kit V4 on Jumia, expanding access to reliable high-speed satellite internet connectivity.


**Dakar, Senegal, August 28, 2026:** Jumia, the leading e-commerce platform in Africa, announces the availability of the Starlink Standard Kit V4 on its marketplace in Senegal, providing consumers and businesses with easier access to reliable, high-speed satellite internet connectivity.


Powered by Starlink's satellite technology, the solution provides internet access in areas where traditional connectivity infrastructure, including fibre or mobile networks, may be limited or unavailable. This makes it particularly relevant for households, businesses and communities in rural and remote areas, as well as locations requiring a reliable internet connection.


*"With Starlink now available on Jumia, we are making it easier for consumers and businesses across Senegal to access reliable connectivity solutions. This collaboration reflects the role e-commerce can play in expanding access to innovative technology and bringing products that improve everyday lives closer to our customers,"* said **Lies Paul Mollard, CEO, Jumia Senegal** .


The Starlink Standard Kit V4 is designed for easy installation and includes the equipment needed to connect to Starlink's satellite internet service, including the Starlink antenna and Wi-Fi router. The kit is available on Jumia Senegal for **165,000 CFA francs (around 250 USD)** .


Jumia's e-commerce platform and logistics capabilities will help make the Starlink Standard Kit V4 accessible to customers across Senegal, offering a convenient way to purchase the technology beyond the country's major urban centres.


The launch further strengthens Jumia's commitment to leveraging technology and its e-commerce ecosystem to improve access to innovative products and services for consumers across Africa.
